failures.description: deploy-command-structural aggregate: two load-dependent deploy-tooling tests failed while all six gates ran concurrently — run-deploy-pipeline.test.py check_observation_validity (holder observation "unknown" instead of "stale") and deploy-test-worker.test.py test_wrong_hash_attachment_or_truncated_inline_without_attachment_is_unverified (native CLI call timed out before the original deadline).
failures.evidence: PR #1695 changes only front-end/ and one docs/rca case (git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD); no scripts/ or deploy tooling. check_observation_validity reproduced locally under CPU contention (16 busy loops / 8 cores): 7 of 8 runs fail with the identical assertion; the suite passes solo (exit 0, "run-deploy-pipeline: all checks passed"). Cause: the test's one-shot sampler stub only yields "stale" if no further sampling pass lands before the joiner decision; run_deploy_pipeline.py re-marks unobserved lanes "unknown" on every pass, so a stretched timeline flips the expectation. deploy-test-worker.test.py passed solo on this devbox earlier in this deploy (exit 0).
